newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-CLIPPERS CENTER WRIGHT SUSPENDED ONE GAME, FINED $5,000.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-CLIPPERS CENTER WRIGHT SUSPENDED ONE GAME, FINED $5,000.

text.p: Los Angeles Clippers rookie centre Lorenzen Wright was suspended for one game and fined $5,000 by the National Basketball Association Tuesday for throwing a flagrant elbow at Dallas Mavericks centre Shawn Bradley on Monday night.
Wright will sit out Tuesday night's game against the Rockets in Houston, NBA senior vice president of basketball operations Rod Thorn said.
The 6-11 (2.11 m) Wright was ejected with 2:20 left in the third quarter of a 99-93 win that clinched a playoff spot for the Clippers after elbowing the 7-6 (2.28 m) Bradley.
The ejection carries an additional automatic $1,000 fine.
